description: Replaces the set of protected paths a plan grants access to. See set_config's description for how to gate a mostly-shared freemium codebase without splitting it into two trees.

plan_id.description: The plan's id, from list_plans or create_plan.

protected_paths.description: Replaces the full set of glob paths this plan grants access to (e.g. ['/premium/**']).

site_id.description: The site's id, from list_sites or create_site.

name: update_plan_paths
title: Update plan protected paths
